observation: Marker sequence ends with a red block after the two green PHY-success blocks: the first qcom_scm_restore_sec_cfg call with device_id 0 returned a non-zero status and nothing follows.
result: The board firmware issues QCOM_SCM_SVC_MP/MP_RESTORE_SEC_CFG through SMC after PHY bring-up; the first call reports failure and the second does not complete. The secure monitor does not hand the UFS SMMU configuration back through this interface on this platform.
limits: Only device_id 0 and 1 were tried, without the call-availability query. A different device id or the newer SMMU_PROGRAM service could still behave differently; none of that is tested.
